name: semantic-scala
description: Bounded Scala compiler, build, test, type, effect, symbol, reconciliation, and SemanticDB evidence for coding agents.
long_description: A local stdio MCP server that delegates to the bundled semantic-scala CLI while retaining access to the user's Scala workspace and build tools. This package is limited to Linux x86_64 and includes its own Java 21 runtime.

tools.name: semantic_compile
tools.description: Compile a bounded Scala workspace through the semantic-scala CLI.

tools.name: semantic_test
tools.description: Run bounded Scala tests and return structured results.

tools.name: semantic_effect_summary
tools.description: Summarize declared functional effects in a Scala source file.

tools.name: semantic_symbol_at
tools.description: Resolve compiler-backed symbol information at a source position.

tools.name: semantic_symbols
tools.description: Read symbols and occurrences from a SemanticDB artifact.

tools.name: semantic_reconcile_symbol
tools.description: Reconcile live compiler and SemanticDB symbol evidence.

tools.name: semantic_point_evidence
tools.description: Return bounded compiler, SemanticDB, freshness, and reconciliation evidence for a source position.
